jobs.description:
For our growing team, we are looking for an experienced Sovereign Cloud / Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to support the secure, reliable, and continuous operation of modern cloud-native and Kubernetes platforms.

You will work with an experienced DevOps/SRE team on highly secure, business-critical platforms, taking responsibility for platform operations, automation, monitoring, incident management, security, and continuous improvement.

The role focuses particularly on Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, logging, and operational excellence within a highly available Unified Observability Platform in a 24x7 operational environment.

Mandatory Requirements – Please Read Before Applying

Citizenship

You must hold valid citizenship in a country that is a full member of both the European Union (EU) and NATO.

If you hold multiple citizenships, all citizenships must be from countries that are members of both the EU and NATO.

Employment in Germany

You must:

- Be employed directly by a legal entity registered in Germany.
- Hold a German employment contract.
- Be subject exclusively to German labor law.
- Comply with all applicable German tax, social-security, and employment regulations.
- Reside in Germany.

Employment through non-German entities, including foreign subcontractors or affiliates, does not meet this requirement.

Security Clearance – Ü2

You must hold a valid and verifiable Ü2 security clearance in accordance with the German Security Clearance Act (Sicherheitsüberprüfungsgesetz – SÜG) and applicable preventive personnel sabotage-protection requirements.

Tasks

Kubernetes & Platform Operations

- Operate and maintain Kubernetes clusters with Gardener, including workloads, deployments, Helm charts and platform components.
- Troubleshoot availability, performance and deployment issues.
- Ensure secure, scalable, resilient and highly available platforms.

CI/CD & Automation

- Operate and optimize Jenkins and ArgoCD pipelines for automated deployments.
- Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Git-based deployment workflows.
- Develop automation and operational tools using Python, Go and/or Bash.
- Automate provisioning, health and compliance checks, alerting and reporting.

Monitoring & Observability

- Manage Prometheus, Thanos and OpenTelemetry environments, including scrape jobs, alert rules and PromQL.
- Develop and maintain Grafana dashboards.
- Continuously improve monitoring and alerting capabilities.

Logging & Log Management

- Operate and optimize Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Logstash and Kibana.
- Monitor log ingestion, storage, performance and reliability.
- Support centralized troubleshooting, anomaly detection, security and compliance.

Integration & Operations

- Integrate observability and logging platforms with ServiceNow, PagerDuty and other enterprise tools via secure APIs.
- Handle operational requests.
- Participate in Scrum, DevOps and service-improvement activities.
- Collaborate with internal teams, SAP, suppliers and stakeholders.

Incident & Problem Management

- Participate in a 24/7 on-call and shift rotation, including weekends and public holidays.
- Respond to platform, monitoring, logging and deployment incidents.
- Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
- Support Major Incident Management (MIM).
- Implement sustainable corrective actions.
- Continuously improve platform stability, resilience and operational processes.

Requirements

Key Technologies

Kubernetes | Gardener | Helm | Jenkins | ArgoCD | Git | IaC | Python | Go | Bash | Prometheus | PromQL | Thanos | OpenTelemetry | Grafana | Elasticsearch | OpenSearch | Logstash | Kibana | ServiceNow | PagerDuty | REST APIs

Technical Skills & Experience

- Proven experience as a Sovereign Cloud Engineer and/or Site Reliability Engineer (SRE).
- Strong experience operating and maintaining Kubernetes clusters, ideally with Gardener.
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes workloads, deployments, Helm charts and platform components.
- Experience troubleshooting availability, performance and deployment issues.
- Experience with Jenkins and ArgoCD for automated CI/CD deployments.
- Solid understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Git-based deployment workflows.
- Programming or scripting experience with Python, Go and/or Bash.
- Experience with automation of provisioning, health checks, compliance checks, alerting and reporting.
- Hands-on experience with Prometheus, PromQL, Thanos and OpenTelemetry.
- Experience developing and maintaining Grafana dashboards and monitoring/alerting solutions.
- Experience with Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Logstash and Kibana.
- Understanding of log ingestion, storage, performance and reliability.
- Experience supporting centralized troubleshooting, anomaly detection, security and compliance.
- Experience integrating platforms with ServiceNow, PagerDuty and other enterprise tools via secure REST APIs.
- Experience with incident management, Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Major Incident Management (MIM).
- Experience working in 24/7 operational environments, including on-call and shift rotations.
- Strong understanding of platform security, scalability, resilience, reliability and high availability.
- Experience working in Scrum and DevOps environments.
- Strong collaboration skills and experience working with internal teams, SAP, suppliers and other stakeholders.

Languages

- English: Required
- German: A plus

Benefits

What You Can Expect

- A technically challenging role within a highly secure and business-critical cloud environment.
- The opportunity to work with modern cloud-native, Kubernetes and observability technologies.
- An international working environment with teams and stakeholders across different locations.
- The opportunity to contribute to automation, platform reliability and continuous improvement.
- Remote / hybrid working possibilities within Germany.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Resident Quality Engineer (f/m/d), you will spend your day working closely with suppliers, manufacturing teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure product quality, production stability, and delivery performance. A significant portion of your role involves being on-site at supplier locations, leading quality escalations, supporting production recovery, and driving sustainable process improvements. You will analyze manufacturing challenges, coordinate corrective actions, conduct audits, and collaborate with engineering and operations teams to strengthen process capability and customer satisfaction. With approximately 25–30% travel, you will play a critical role in maintaining quality excellence across the supply chain.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Deployment to supplier sites as a dedicated quality escalation expert to stabilize production following critical quality, technical, or delivery issues
* Leadership of immediate containment activities to prevent defect escapes, protect customers, and maintain operational continuity
* Development and management of supplier recovery plans including action tracking, milestone management, accountability, and executive reporting
* Execution of root cause analyses, manufacturing process reviews, and quality audits to identify risks, process gaps, and improvement opportunities
* Definition, implementation, validation, and sustainability tracking of corrective and preventive actions to address both short-term and systemic issues
* Collaboration with supplier engineering, quality, and operations teams to improve process capability, product quality, manufacturing efficiency, and long-term performance

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related technical discipline
* Extensive experience in quality management, manufacturing environments, supplier quality, and production process improvement
* Strong expertise in root cause analysis, problem-solving methodologies, Kaizen, supplier recovery activities, and critical manufacturing process assessments
* Proven ability to identify technical failure mechanisms, implement sustainable process improvements, and ensure long-term effectiveness of corrective actions
* Experience working in cross-functional and international environments, ideally with turbine hot gas components or other complex manufacturing technologies
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills, combined with fluency in German and English and willingness to travel approximately 25–30% to supplier locations worldwide

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

jobs.occupation: Sales Director (f/m/d) Test & Validation - DACH (Leiter/in - Vertrieb)
jobs.description:
Shape the Future of Engineering Test & Validation

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation - helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Our Testing business sits at the heart of this transformation. As products become more software-defined, connected, electrified, and complex, manufacturers need to bring together physical testing, data acquisition, simulation, analysis, and engineering software into a connected validation process.
This creates a significant growth opportunity - and we are looking for an exceptional commercial leader to lead it across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (DACH).

The Opportunity
As Test Country Lead (w/m/d) DACH, you will own the commercial success and growth of the Siemens Test business across the region.
You will lead the Sales and PreSales organization while remaining highly visible in the market and directly engaged with strategic customers. This is a player-coach leadership role: you will build and develop a high-performing organization while personally shaping major opportunities, executive relationships, and strategic accounts.
You will spend at least 50% of your time with strategic customers and in the market, ensuring that you remain close to customer priorities, technology trends, competitive dynamics, and the opportunities shaping the future of engineering test and validation.
This is an opportunity to build and grow a significant business in one of the world's most important engineering markets, supported by Siemens' global technology portfolio, resources, and customer relationships.
What you will ownLead the DACH Test Business

- Own the overall commercial performance of the Test business across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.- Drive revenue, growth, profitability, and market-share objectives across hardware, software, maintenance, and customer & engineering services.- Define and execute the regional business strategy and annual operating plan.- Identify new growth opportunities, markets, customers, and routes to market.- Establish clear commercial priorities, KPIs, and accountability across the organization.

Lead from the Market- Personally engage with strategic customers and executive stakeholders, building trusted relationships at C-level and senior engineering levels.- Lead major strategic sales pursuits and complex, multi-year opportunities.- Develop compelling value propositions and quantified business cases that connect technology investment to measurable customer outcomes.- Understand customer engineering and validation challenges and translate them into differentiated Siemens solutions.- Maintain a strong understanding of market trends, competitor strategies, technology shifts, and emerging customer requirements.- Represent Siemens Test at customer events, industry conferences, and executive forums.

Build a High-Performing Sales Organization- Lead, coach, and develop the DACH Sales and PreSales organization.- Recruit and retain exceptional commercial and technical sales talent.- Create a culture of accountability, customer obsession, collaboration, and continuous improvement.- Align individual strengths and expertise with strategic market opportunities.- Establish clear development and succession plans for key roles.- Raise the overall standard of consultative, value-based, and solution-oriented selling.

Win in a Competitive Market- Develop differentiated strategies for strategic accounts and competitive opportunities.- Build strong account and territory plans that increase market penetration and customer value.- Lead competitive positioning across the Test & Validation landscape.- Govern Proof-of-Concept engagements with clear success criteria, commercial objectives, and transition plans.- Develop and manage a high-performing partner ecosystem to extend market reach and accelerate growth.

Connect Customers with Siemens Technology

- Work closely with global Product Management, Industry, Engineering, and Services teams to bring the right solutions to customers.- Ensure that customer feedback and market intelligence directly influence regional and global strategy.- Drive adoption of the broader Siemens portfolio by connecting test, measurement, simulation, engineering software, and services into compelling customer solutions.- Ensure operational excellence through accurate forecasting, disciplined opportunity management, reliable demonstrations, and measurable sales performance.

What You Bring

We are looking for an accomplished Sales Director, Business Leader, or Commercial Leader who combines strong sales leadership with a deep understanding of engineering-driven technology markets, especially in test & validation.

- A successful track record in B2B sales leadership within engineering software, test & measurement, validation, simulation, industrial technology, or a closely related field- Experience leading Sales and PreSales organizations with direct responsibility for regional business performance.- A proven record of winning complex, high-value opportunities involving multiple technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders.- Strong experience developing strategic accounts and building long-term relationships with senior engineering and executive decision-makers.- Experience selling solutions such as test & measurement, data acquisition, test automation, validation, simulation, NVH, HIL/XIL, engineering software, or related technologies is highly valuable.- Strong commercial judgment and demonstrated success in negotiations and complex deal structures.- The ability to translate sophisticated technology into clear customer value and compelling business outcomes.- Experience building, coaching, and motivating high-performing sales organizations.- A strong external network and understanding of the DACH engineering and manufacturing ecosystem.- Experience working with strategic partners and developing indirect routes to market.- Strong understanding of industries such as Automotive & Transportation, Aerospace & Defense, Electronics & Semiconductors, Energy, and Industrial Machinery.- Excellent executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and storytelling skills.- Willingness to travel regularly across the DACH region and internationally.- Highly proficient spoken and written German and English.

Why Us

We are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across many countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Our Benefits & Rewards

Austria: €162,200 – €308,300

This position may also be posted in additional locations beyond those specified above. For such locations, the applicable salary ranges and benefits will be disclosed by the Talent Acquisition Partner at the time of initial contact, in accordance with local legal requirements.

jobs.occupation: Head of Global Research & Development and Technology  (f/m/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description:
Electricity is becoming the operating system of the world economy. Decarbonized industry, electrified transport and heat, and the computing infrastructure required for artificial intelligence all depend on reliable and innovative electrical products and distribution systems.

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on executive to lead our global Research & Development and Technology organization. In this role, you will combine the operational leadership of a large, globally distributed R&D organization with the strategic responsibility for the technology roadmap of Siemens Electrical Products. You will shape the continued development of our strong electromechanical portfolio while accelerating the integration of power electronics, electronics, connectivity, software, and intelligent product capabilities across Europe, India, China, and other international locations. **What will be your role and responsibilities? **
Strategic R&D and Technology Leadership- Define and implement an integrated global R&D and technology strategy across product programs, technology roadmaps, platforms, architectures, and selected exploratory initiatives to strengthen long-term competitiveness and sustainable growth.   - Lead a global R&D and Technology organization of more than 1,000 employees across Europe, India, China, and further international locations, with responsibility for an R&D budget in the triple-digit million-euro range.   - Drive the R&D contribution to the company programs and align technology roadmaps, platform strategies, development priorities, and resource allocation across Electrical Products.    - As a direct report and strategic technology partner to the pre of Electrical Products, you will translate long-term industry and technology trends into clear portfolio, platform, capability, and organizational priorities.

**Technology and Portfolio Development  ** - Shape the future portfolio by further developing the electromechanical product foundation while expanding power-electronics- and semiconductor-based solutions, advancing direct-current architectures, and enabling connected, software-supported products.   - Advance the secure connectivity and IoT strategy and evaluate how data management and artificial intelligence can create measurable customer and product value.   - Lead the evolution toward increasingly connected, intelligent, and updatable products by integrating electronics, communication, software, cybersecurity, and cloud capabilities into a strong electromechanical product portfolio, while ensuring quality and regulatory compliance.   - Embed sustainability into engineering and product decisions by advancing circular and repairable design, eco-design, material efficiency, lower losses, and a reduced product carbon footprint.

R&D Excellence - Lead the global R&D footprint, capacity allocation, capability development, and collaboration across development locations, with clear missions and end-to-end accountability for product development.   - Provide hands-on leadership for the execution of product and development roadmaps, working closely with Product Management to translate market requirements into differentiated, competitive, and technically robust products.   - Remain close to products, laboratories, development teams, and manufacturing environments, enabling fact-based technical decisions and effective problem-solving directly where products are designed and developed.   - Advance platform, architecture, and reuse strategies through modular solutions, virtual validation, and pre-certified building blocks, improving development efficiency, product quality, and time-to-market.   - Modernize R&D through model-based systems engineering, digital continuity from requirements to field data, simulation-led design, and the targeted use of artificial intelligence in R&D processes.   - Strengthen the global R&D environment by harmonizing product lifecycle management tools, increasing platform consistency, and fostering effective collaboration and knowledge sharing across segments and development locations.

**Representation and People Leadership  ** - Represent R&D and Technology toward the president, senior business and technology partners, Product Management, manufacturing, quality, and selected external partners, customers, research institutions, industry associations, and international standards bodies.   - Lead, motivate, and develop senior leaders, technical experts, and employees across a globally distributed organization, building a high-performance, collaborative, and innovation-driven engineering culture with strong leadership and technical succession pipelines.   - This is a highly presence-oriented leadership role. You will work regularly at our key development and product locations, with a strong presence in Amberg, Germany, where a significant part of the organization is based. International travel and the flexibility to spend extended periods at global sites are essential.

**What you need to make a difference: **

- An advanced academic degree or equivalent qualification in electrical engineering or a closely related technical field. Candidates with a background in physics may also be considered if they bring extensive professional experience in the electrical or electrification industry. A doctorate is an advantage.   - Extensive professional experience, including significant executive leadership responsibility within large, globally distributed R&D and Engineering organizations spanning multiple development centers and cultures - Deep technical and product experience in electrical engineering, electrification, electromechanical systems, or comparable industrial products, combined with a sound understanding of power electronics, electronics, embedded software, connectivity, and system architecture.   - The ability to combine strategic technology leadership with hands-on operational R&D management and to engage credibly in detailed discussions about products, systems, architectures, and engineering trade-offs.   - A strong track record in transforming R&D organizations, technology portfolios, platforms, architectures, and global engineering capabilities, translated into successful products and measurable business results.   - Experience in managing technology and product portfolios, leading global R&D organizations, overseeing significant innovation investments, and driving strategic make, partner, or buy decisions. - Strong critical thinking and business sense, with the ability to set clear priorities, make evidence-based technology and investment decisions, and discontinue activities that do not support the strategic direction.   - The ability to navigate a complex global matrix, establish clear decision rights, resolve conflicts constructively, and collaborate closely with business leaders, Product Management, manufacturing, quality, and other multi-functional partners.   - Excellent executive communication and partner management skills, combined with the ability to develop senior leaders, technical experts, and successors in a global organization.   - An international approach, fluency in English, and proven experience in leading across countries and cultures. German and additional languages are an advantage. The role requires regular on-site presence at key development locations, particularly in Amberg, as well as extensive international travel and global mobility.

rate, margin and liquidity cash flow analyses. In addition, you design

develop solutions to implement IRRBB and CSRBB requirements as well as
net interest income (NII) simulations. As part of your role, you also
ensure the effective integration of regulatory requirements, for
instance with respect to ICAAP and ILAAP as well as IRRBB and CSRBB.
You take responsibility for your own deliverables and those of your
team and proactively advance topics. With your strong team orientation
and professionalism, you foster trust-based collaboration – both
within the team and with our clients. You also mentor junior
colleagues, developing both their professional capabilities and
personal strengths, and thus contribute to the team’s growth. You
actively help shape the ongoing enhancement of our consulting
portfolio, identify relevant market potential at an early stage and
derive concrete ideas from it. With your expertise, you support the
development of new offerings and the acquisition of new client
mandates. Your skills: You hold a degree in mathematics, (business)
informatics, physics, statistics or economics, ideally supplemented by
certifications such as FRM or CFA. You have at least three years of
professional experience in consulting or the financial industry.
Proven involvement in leading bank-specific implementation projects in
liquidity and market price risk management is an advantage, and
initial exposure to specialist leadership (for example coordinating
team members) is also part of your profile. You have a solid
understanding of liquidity and market price risk management as well as
the ICAAP and ILAAP frameworks. You confidently apply your analytical
and quantitative skills in modeling and data analysis; programming
skills in Python or R are explicitly welcome. You are familiar with
relevant European and German regulatory requirements, including EBA
Guidelines on IRRBB and CSRBB, SREP requirements, ICAAP and ILAAP.
Initial experience in dealing professionally with external audits is a
plus. You work and think in a structured and solution-oriented manner
and communicate clearly. A client- and team-oriented way of working
comes naturally to you, especially when assuming responsibility within
a team and engaging effectively with different people and situations.
You have excellent command of the German language (at least C1 level,
business-fluent proficiency) and good English language skills (at
least B2 level, fluent), both written and spoken. #LI-LARA #LI-hybrid

jobs.occupation: (Senior) Global Brand Manager / Team Lead (m/f/d) (Leiter/in - Brand Management)
jobs.description:
Nature offers increasing opportunities. Grow with us. Bionorica, with
approximately 2200 employees worldwide, is the German market leader
for pharmacy-only herbal medicines. For over 90 years, we have been
unlocking the secrets of nature by combining the knowledge of
traditional medicinal plant therapy with the forward-looking results
of scientific research. "Phytoneering” is the formula of our success
with which we have been on a growth course for years. In this way, we
open up new markets with innovative, highly effective herbal
medicines. For our location in Neumarkt (Oberpfalz), we are looking
for a: (Senior) Global Brand Manager / Team Lead (m/f/d) To strengthen
our Global Brand Management team, we are looking for a creative and
strategic (Senior) Global Brand Manager / Team Lead – Franchise Head
(m/f/d) who will take responsibility for our respiratory (Sinupret) or
women´s health (Canephron) products. These are the tasks for this
position: Development of a mid-term vision, ambition, and strategy for
our brands in the respiratory (Sinupret) or women´s health
(Canephron) products sector, taking into account country-specific
market conditions and cultural differences Design and maintenance of
brand identity, ensuring brand consistency across all channels
Responsibility for the entire brand experience throughout the product
lifecycle Conducting analysis of campaign results and consumer
insights for continuous improvement Management and maintenance of
global brand books to ensure a consistent brand presence Conducting
market and consumer research to derive actionable insights Leading the
product portfolio and lifecycle management (LCM) to maximize market
success Planning and monitoring brand budgets to ensure financial
efficiency Sharing, reusing, and leading the global brand community to
promote best practices Developing and implementing strategies to
increase brand awareness and attractiveness Creating core creative
ideas and campaigns to support our global brand strategy Defining
compelling brand stories based on deep consumer insights Close
collaboration with relevant country colleagues Depending on
experience, qualifications and organizational needs, the role may
include team leadership responsibility, contributing to the
development of franchise priorities, capability building, and the
successful delivery of business objectives These are the requirements
you should meet: Completed studies in marketing, business
administration, or similar experience Several years of experience in
brand management, ideally in the pharmaceutical or herbal sector
Proven track record in developing and implementing brand strategies
and campaigns Strong analytical skills and experience in conducting
market research Creativity combined with a strategic approach Ideally
first experiences with the "How Brands Grow" approach on
evidence-based marketing Ability to work in a dynamic international
environment and lead cross-functional teams (optional: previous
experience leading a team) Proficiency in English (both written and
spoken), basic German knowledge would be an advantage We offer you: A
globally operating, family-owned company with a commitment to social
responsibility Flexible working hours and home office options to
support the balance between work and personal life Responsible fields
of activity with a thorough onboarding process and performance-based
compensation with attractive social benefits and company pension
scheme Exciting prospects in a globally growing company with a wide
range of professional and personal development opportunities
Compensation – Global Brand Manager: Compensation is governed by the
company's collective bargaining agreement, which is aligned with the
German Chemical Industry Collective Pay Agreement (BETV Chemie). The
anticipated salary grades are: Global Brand Manager: pay grade E 10/6
K to E 12/6 K, depending on qualifications and professional experience
Senior Global Brand Manager: pay grade E 13 K The monthly gross salary
for a full-time position (39.5 hours / week) ranges from approximately
5.422 € (E 10/6 K) to 6.819 € (E 13 K), depending on the
applicable pay grade. In addition, employees may be eligible for an
above-tariff allowance, a performance-related bonus linked to target
achievement, and further benefits in accordance with company policies.
Compensation – Team Lead: This position is compensated outside the
scope of the collective bargaining agreement. The starting salary is
determined based on a current market benchmark and the candidate's
profile and is expected to range between 96.000 € and 105.000 €
gross salary per annum, depending on qualifications and experience. In
addition, employees are eligible for a performance-related bonus
linked to target achievement, as well as benefits in accordance with
company policies. Contact: Are you open to new opportunities? Then
take your chance. Please apply through our online application form. We
look forward to meeting you! Join us! Contact person Bionorica SE
People & Organisation Theresa Frank www.bionorica.de
